macroCheckin.title: Macro check-in
macroCheckin.body: Aapka {{checkpoint}} check-in off-track hai: {{summary}}. Next meal ko count karein.

missingMeal.title: Apna {{meal}} log karein
missingMeal.body: Lagta hai {{meal}} abhi log nahi hua. Fresh hai toh abhi add karein.

missingWorkout.title: Workout log missing
missingWorkout.body: Aaj koi workout log nahi hua. Apna session log karein ya plan mein rest day mark karein.

streakRisk.title: Apni streak protect karein
streakRisk.body: Aaj aapne meals ya training log nahi ki. Day end hone se pehle ek quick entry add karein.

weeklyDigest.title: Aapka NexRep weekly digest
weeklyDigest.body: Is week: {{mealsLogged}} nutrition days, {{workoutsLogged}} workouts, {{strengthLifts}} strength lifts logged. Next plan karne ke liye NexRep open karein.
